resources: BUGGY RULES /n 1. A game of bug is initiated by the announcing of Bug or Buggy, any one who wishes to play may, but is responsible for keeping their own score.(Now thanks to the Buggy app scores are logged-with with picture proof of "buggy's".) /n 2. Buggy's are Volkswagen beetle cars that are found driving around on the road approximately from 1964-2022 models all beetles are subject to the game of buggy. /n 3. Car lots with Buggy's are exempt from counting. /n 4. 8 Bug's initiates a "Slug Bug". The slug bug score wins the round, all buggy counts reset to zero. The slug bug score is tallied as a score in the winners circle for high score record.
